row:
Photonic Health is your provider of the tools and education that allow you to be proactive in the health, and the physical & emotional well-being of all your pets. Photonic Health is also your answer if your pet becomes injured or sick. We provide tools and knowledge you use to be proactive and allow you to take your pet out of pain and accelerate its healing process.  

Our relationship does not end with purchasing your light therapy device from us; it has only begun. We are here for you to provide you whatever information/education you need to use your light most effectively in just about any circumstance you may encounter.  


Phone:  855-436-7082
Email: info@photonichealth.com
Website: https://photonichealth.com
Facebook: https://facebook.com/PhotonicHealth
Twitter: https://twitter.com/PhotonicHealth
Instagram: https://instagram.com/PhotonicHealth

#redlighttherapy #lighttherapy #horses #dogs #cats #photonics #photobiomodulation #photonichealth
